title: IDF, Shin Bet Kill Hamas Rafah Brigade Commander Nael Abu Obeid
detail: The IDF and Shin Bet said they killed Nael Abu Obeid, commander of Hamas's Rafah Brigade, in a strike in the southern Gaza Strip on September 15, 2026. Abu Obeid succeeded Mohammad Shabanah, who was killed in May 2025, and had previously served as the brigade's deputy commander and as commander of its Tel al-Sultan and Yibna Battalions. Army Radio reported the IDF and Shin Bet had tracked him for weeks; he rarely moved alone, staying among other people or inside populated areas as a security precaution. Prime Minister Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz said the strike showed 'no terrorist is immune, and Hamas will not be in Gaza.'

title: Israeli Strikes Destroy Tents at Abu Khadra Camp, Kill Two
detail: Israeli strikes hit the Abu Khadra displacement camp on September 15, 2026, destroying four tents and killing at least two people in a passageway between shelters, according to camp manager Shaaban Abu Zeidieh; footage showed damaged tents, bloodstains and belongings scattered across the ground. The Israeli military said it carried out four strikes that day targeting militants. Health officials also reported additional strikes in Zawaida, central Gaza, and in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, as part of ongoing ceasefire violations.
